decision: As KerML 8.2.4.1.2 states it: `general = [QualifiedName]`, or `general += OwnedFeatureChain` with the chain owned by the relationship. The cross-reference parses a QualifiedName, and the `{ ownedRelatedElement += general }` action consumes no tokens. The pilot Xtext has no rule of this name, so there is no second opinion. It inlines this body into each rule that uses it.

evidence.note: GeneralType : Specialization = general = [QualifiedName] | general += OwnedFeatureChain { ownedRelatedElement += general }
line 22: `feature g subsets f.a;`, the OwnedFeatureChain alternative, reached through Subsets and OwnedSubsetting
`portion focusedState: Camera subsets timeSlices;`, the QualifiedName alternative

notes: re-scoped (ADR-0015): only the kerml grammar reaches this production, so its work now lives in GeneralType@kerml
